column1: # Nightly fuzz count budgets (G6). One row per calibrated target:
# measured_execs_10m is what the target reached in a 10-minute nightly run on
# it, so a target spends about 8 minutes inside its 15-minute job.
# A count budget (-fuzztime <N>x) has no wall-clock deadline, so it avoids the
# Go fuzz engine's deadline race (golang/go#76901: a duration budget that runs
# out mid-worker reports "context deadline exceeded" as a failure).
# A target with no row falls back to FUZZ_NIGHTLY_FUZZTIME. check_fuzz_policy.sh
# refuses a row for an undiscovered target or a budget above its measurement.
